The log file `/tmp/r3_oec_retry.log` should contain entries for each checkpoint (e.g., lines like `step_00001234: wiki_ppl …`) as well as messages indicating when training finished or when each STM round completed. By extracting those lines I can see the trajectory of wiki perplexity, BLiMP, ARC, etc., across steps and confirm whether there was a drop after the champion checkpoint.

The most straightforward way is to grep for all lines that start with `step_000` followed by any digits and a colon, then limit to the first 30 matches to get a representative sample of early to mid‑training scores. Additionally, I should look for any “training done” or “stm round … done” markers to know if the run completed its intended schedule or stopped early (perhaps due to the earlier CUDA fault).

This will give me the data I need to assess whether the later training truly degraded the model or if the run simply never got past the early checkpoint.
